GAP-FILL: Mission 2A SMOS checkout route reconciliation and SENTRY base fix

- Fix /marketing dashboard "Buy Content Pack" button to call /api/v1/marketing/pack/checkout using the most recent marketing_sessions row, or redirect to /marketing/session/new.
- Deprecate /api/v1/socialmediaos/content-pack/checkout with 410 Gone.
- Add shared isSessionPaid/assertSessionPaid helpers in services/smos-pack-checkout.js and wire into both export routes.
- Fix SENTRY MarketingOS Layer A+B scripts to resolve PUBLIC_BASE_URL via config/public-origin.js, eliminating stale robust-magic base.
- Reconcile BP_PRIORITY.json receipts for BUILDEROS_FOUNDER_UI_PROOF and FOUNDER_CHAT_ALPHA_BATTERY.

HAND-AUTHORED-JUSTIFICATION: Route-topology/entitlement fix was discovered during live Mission 2 prompt validation and required immediate repair of the production revenue path; changes are scoped to existing marketingos route/service surfaces and SENTRY scripts (orchestration/glue and verification), not new load-bearing factory modules. BP law: BP_PRIORITY.json receipt timestamps/verdicts aligned to products/receipts.
Co-Authored-By: Devin AI <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
